commentary.executiveSummary: Macwest Limited achieved an exceptional 120.2% year-on-year revenue scale-up in Q1 2026, reaching GH¢ 12.73M. Gross profit expanded by 172.4% to GH¢ 4.33M, driven by improved cost efficiencies and higher-margin project delivery. While operating expenses rose by 179.2% in line with strategic capacity expansion, the company delivered a 72.3% growth in net profit (GH¢ 159.8k), confirming the robust scalability of the current operational model.
commentary.pnlAnalysis: The 120% revenue growth significantly outpaced the 100% increase in costs of revenue, leading to a margin expansion in gross profit from 27.5% in Q1 2025 to 34.0% in Q1 2026. Management attention is currently focused on optimizing operating leverage as capacity investments stabilize.
commentary.balanceSheetAnalysis: The balance sheet shows significant liquidity strength with cash reserves of GH¢ 5.76M. Operational leverage is being managed to fund project-specific working capital needs without external bank debt.

risks.description: High growth in OPEX requires sustained revenue scale to maintain net margins.
Revenue remains concentrated in key infrastructure projects (ENI).
Scaling project delivery capacity to match the 120% YoY volume increase.
